en: Colorized historical postcard view of a European town square with a central fountain and statue ensemble surrounded by café tables and parasols. Multi‑story buildings with green shutters encircle the square, and shops with German signage line the ground floors. On a hill in the background stands a prominent clock tower and fortification. At the top left, printed text reads "Graz. Hauptplatz".
